## Raw dump (verbatim)

There is a new scheduling tool feature that auto-assigns tasks based on team capacity. I want to react to it. My angle is that the feature is useful but it is not the point. People will buy the tool and still be slammed because they never built the system the tool is supposed to run. The tool is the kitchen appliance, the system is the recipe.

I do not want to name the exact tool in the video, the point is bigger than one product.

The viewer outcome is to write the process down before they buy any tool to run it.

I am reacting because everyone in my audience is about to get sold on this feature this week.
